cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(GwrlCore LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT WIN32)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "GWRL uses the Windows local named-pipe transport")
endif()
if(NOT TARGET glaze::glaze)
    find_package(glaze CONFIG REQUIRED)
endif()
add_library(gwrl-core STATIC src/Wire.cpp src/Transport.cpp src/Router.cpp)
add_library(GWRL::Core ALIAS gwrl-core)
target_compile_features(gwrl-core PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
target_include_directories(gwrl-core PUBLIC include)
target_compile_definitions(gwrl-core PUBLIC NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN ZMIJ_USE_SIMD=0)
target_link_libraries(gwrl-core PUBLIC glaze::glaze PRIVATE bcrypt advapi32)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(gwrl-core PRIVATE /W4 /WX /EHsc /utf-8)
endif()
